svg.text: #607 Enterprise Energy & Power Grid AI: Weather Foundation + SCOPF Solver + Substation VLM
Cloud & AI Solution Architect Guide · 5,000 Wind/Solar/Substation Sites · Cuts Forecast MAPE from 14.2% to 5.8% · Zero N-1 Physics Violations
1. Neuro-Symbolic Power Grid Dispatch Pipeline
Stage 1: Probabilistic Wind/Solar/Load Forecasting (2× H100)
• GraphCast / Pangu-Weather NWP + Chronos 15-min telemetry fine-tuning
• Emits P10/P50/P90 quantiles across 5,000 sites in 45s · MAPE: 14.2% → 5.8%!
Stage 2: Deterministic SCOPF Physics Solver (Never Let LLM Set MW!)
• Feeds P10/P90 bounds into Security-Constrained Optimal Power Flow (Gurobi/cuOpt)
• Enforces Kirchhoff's laws, voltage bounds & N-1 transmission line contingencies
• 0.0% Physics Violations (vs. 19.4% line thermal overload on unconstrained LLM dispatch)
Stage 3: Grid Dispatcher Copilot & Spot-Market Bidding Assistant
• Explains binding transmission constraints & NERC/FERC switching procedures
• Runs on 2× H200 inside NERC-CIP air-gapped control center enclave
2. Substation Drone/IR Inspection & Grid Financial ROI
Drone & Fixed Thermal Camera Inspection Funnel (500,000 Images/Day)
• Edge Jetson YOLOv11 filters 98.5% normal towers/insulators locally
• Only 1.5% (7,500 crops/day) hit 2× L40S Qwen2.5-VL for micro-crack, rust, bird-nest
& IR hotspot ΔT > 15°C grading → 98.9% insulator defect recall!
Regional Utility AI Fleet & Imbalance Penalty Savings
• Complete Utility Fleet: 2× L40S (Substation VLM) + 2× H100 (Weather NWP) +
2× H200 (SCOPF + NERC-CIP Dispatcher Copilot) = 6 GPUs ($13,300/month)
• Cuts Day-Ahead Spot Market Imbalance Penalties by 59.2% ($9.40M/year saved!)
• Reduces curtailment of renewable wind/solar generation by 34.0%
3. Critical Infrastructure NERC-CIP / IEC-62443 Unidirectional Data Diode Rule
• Never connect cloud LLMs bidirectionally to OT SCADA/EMS breaker controls!
• Stream SCADA telemetry out via optical unidirectional Data Diode, and run dispatcher copilots inside the air-gapped OT/DMZ zone.
